brief.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Create exactly ONE finished Japanese basketball editorial thumbnail, landscape 1920x1080 (16:9), PNG, all artwork and text inside safe margins. This is a new hand-drawn illustration with complete Japanese typography, not a photo or photo collage.

Editorial context strictly from the fixed article: November 18, 2026 B.PREMIER games are all pregame at 03:25 JST; official records are pending. There is no reported result, player performance, or confirmed participation. The illustration is a generic play image and must not look like documentary evidence of this day's actual game.

Visual style: approved basketball publication style, deep ink black #151A18 ground, electric lime #CCF43B, warm ivory typography, confident hand-drawn ink and dry-brush marks, energetic diagonal strokes, strong negative space, very few elements. Clearly drawn editorial sports illustration, recognizable facial structure but never photographic. High-contrast bold Japanese gothic typography, lime date, ivory headline. No team or league graphic logos, no sponsor graphics, no photo assets.

Subject: ONE real athlete, Christopher Smith of Hiroshima Dragonflies, selected randomly among the official current roster of a team mentioned in the article. He is not the article's featured best performer. Do not print his name anywhere. Use these visually verified features from the official portrait: a medium-dark brown-skinned athletic adult man, closely braided black cornrows going straight back from the forehead with small braid ends behind the ears, closely shaved sides, high forehead, long oval face, strong cheekbones, straight substantial nose, dark almond-shaped eyes with near-horizontal eyebrows, short neat mustache connected to short goatee and close-cropped jaw beard, strong neck and powerful shoulders. Tattoos visible on both upper arms, simplified as ink shading. A black sleeve on his right arm. Render his likeness as expressive ink contours with ivory and warm gray highlights; facial details clear and not lost in darkness. Plain light ivory basketball jersey and shorts with dark side panels; NO jersey text, NO numbers, NO emblems. Do not draw a generic invented athlete.

Pose/composition: on the RIGHT 45% of the frame, Christopher Smith leans forward into a low driving dribble, knees bent, torso turned three-quarter toward viewer, face clearly visible and focused looking toward the open court on the left. Show him from head to below the knees, with both shoulders, elbows, wrists and hands completely legible. His RIGHT hand is naturally pressing down onto the top of an orange basketball at hip level, fingers naturally spread with anatomically correct joints; left arm bent naturally as balance. Keep entire ball and hands inside frame. Cropping below the knees is intentional. Use energetic diagonal lime brush strokes BEHIND the figure. No opponent, no other humans, no hoop, no scoreboard, no arena photograph. This is an imagined generic play, not a specific scoring or winning scene.

Layout and exact text ONLY, every line accurately legible:
Small top-left masthead: "バスケまとめ"
Small text below masthead: "B.PREMIER"
Very large lime date on left upper-middle: "11/18"
Very large bold ivory title below the date: "試合予定"
Two smaller clear lines in the lower left:
"全試合 試合前"
"公式記録確定待ち"
Small but comfortably readable source timestamp below them:
"2026.11.18 03:25 JST時点"
Bottom safe footer in ivory, separated from art with negative space:
"イラスト（AI生成）"
"イメージ"

No other words, names, digits, stats, rankings, scores or claim of athlete appearance. Do not reproduce any wording from other thumbnail examples. The statement about pregame is explicitly qualified by the timestamp. Keep text and face clear, no overlaps, no clipped glyphs. Preserve the understated footer labels exactly.
